basic_details.job_title: NeGD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 16 Program Manager, DevOps Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD), an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, is inviting applications for 16 positions purely on contract basis, initially for 3 years and extendable as per the requirement of the project. The posts are Program Manager (5), Quality Analyst (AI) (5), Full stack Developer (AI) (3) and DevOps Engineer (AI/ML) (3). The maximum age is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ by 30 Novemb

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/. The last date for submission of applications is 30 November 2026. The notice says the details can be downloaded from www.dic.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in. It does not describe the steps of the online form.

No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies. They may apply through proper channel or attach the certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.
important_instructions: NeGD reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the positions advertised, without assigning any reason. NeGD reserves the right not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason. The place of posting will be New Delhi but transferable to project locations of NeGD as per existing policy of NeGD/DIC. For queries, contact the HR Team, National e Governance Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003, Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About NeGD
content_sections.text: The National e-Governance Division is based at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi. The notice says NeGD supports MeitY in programme management and in implementing e-Governance projects of Central and State Ministries and Departments. Its initiatives under the Digital India Programme include DigiLocker, UMANG, Poshan Tracker, OpenForge Platform, API Setu, National Academic Depository, Academic Bank of Credits and Learning Management System.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 16 vacancies in total across four positions. A category-wise break-up is not printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for all posts is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice gives no age relaxation. Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with a strong verifiable delivery record will be considered in lieu of formal qualification. Experience: 10+ years in technology delivery (12+ years preferred), with a minimum of 3 years managing AI, data or platform programme delivery. Demonstrable delivery of at least one multi-team technology programme with external vendors, with documented scope, budget and outcomes. Experience with milestone-based contracts, acceptance and payment against evidence, and with governance reporting to senior leadership, boards or steering committees. Experience leading product managers, business analysts or programme staff. Government experience is not required. Experience: 5+ years in QA and Software Testing. Hands-on experience in AI/ML and Generative AI application testing is mandatory. Experience in LLM testing, prompt testing and AI response validation; knowledge of hallucination detection and RAG testing. Strong experience in Selenium, Cypress, Playwright or equivalent automation tools; API testing tools such as Postman and Rest Assured; familiarity with JIRA, TestRail and Agile methodologies. Preferred: experience in testing AI-powered enterprise applications, LLM-based platforms, AI chatbots and automated AI evaluation frameworks. Experience: minimum 5-7 years in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, System Administration or related roles. Proven experience in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD or CircleCI; hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and container orchestration. Experience managing cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud; strong Linux/Unix administration and scripting. Hands-on experience with AI/ML-based applications, AI model deployment or MLOps practices is required. Preferred certifications: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Docker or other containerisation certifications, relevant cloud, AI/ML or MLOps certifications. Candidates with strong verifiable work (production applications or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification. Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack development (5+ years preferred), with a minimum of 2 years building and deploying AI- or ML-powered features in production applications. Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of at least one production web application, and delivery of at least one LLM or ML-powered application to end users. Hands-on experience with Python and TypeScript in production and with React-based frontends; experience deploying containerised applications on cloud platforms through CI/CD pipelines. A plus: experience in fine-tuning or self-hosting models, working in regulated sectors, or building Indian-language applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention the pay. All four positions are purely on contract basis, initially for a period of 3 years, further extendable as per the requirement of the project. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of NeGD/DIC. Appointees will not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC, or on any vacancies existing or advertised in future. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments with a notice of one month, or without any notice by paying one month's salary in lieu of the notice period. The designation of selected candidates will be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Program Manager (AI) runs delivery across a portfolio of AI projects for government departments, covering in-house teams and empanelled agencies, and leads the Product Managers and Business Analysts. Integrated Portfolio Planning: maintain one integrated plan covering milestones, dependencies, the critical path and capacity. Vendor and Contract Management: track agency milestones and service levels, coordinate acceptance with technical leads and the QA Lead, release payments against evidence, and manage change requests. Governance and Reporting: prepare monthly reports for steering and oversight committees, prepare fund-utilisation reports with the finance team, and maintain audit-ready records. Approvals, Data Access and Dependencies: track and unblock departmental approvals, data-sharing agreements, compute allocations and security clearances. Portfolio Metrics: track use cases live, adoption, quality, cost and spend against plan, and flag variances early. PMO Operations: run weekly reviews, decision logs and the register of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies. Team Leadership: lead and develop the Product Managers and Business Analysts. Technical competencies listed: programme management (integrated planning, critical path, earned value; Jira Advanced Roadmaps, MS Project or Smartsheet); milestone-based contracts, service levels, change control and budget tracking; Agile, Scrum and SAFe at portfolio level; the AI and software delivery lifecycle; advanced Excel or Google Sheets and Power BI or Superset; concise status reports. The QA Engineer (AI) leads the quality assurance function, ensuring the reliability, performance and accuracy of software applications and AI-powered solutions. The notice gives the location for this post as Delhi. Lead and mentor QA engineers and oversee end-to-end testing activities. Develop test strategies, test plans and automation frameworks. Manage functional, integration, regression, API and performance testing. Test AI/ML-based applications, Generative AI and LLM-powered solutions; validate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance and consistency. Identify AI hallucinations, bias, incorrect outputs and prompt-related issues. Test AI chatbots, RAG-based applications and conversational AI solutions. Drive test automation and AI-based testing initiatives; coordinate with development, DevOps and AI/ML teams. Monitor defect resolution, quality metrics and release readiness. The role covers managing scalable and secure infrastructure, streamlining application deployments, and enabling reliable delivery of conventional and AI-powered applications supporting e-governance initiatives under the Digital India programme. Infrastructure Automation: build and maintain CI/CD pipelines; Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible or CloudFormation; Linux/Unix system administration. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies: Program Manager 5, Quality Analyst (AI) 5, Full stack Developer (AI) 3 and DevOps Engineer (AI/ML) 3.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 30 November 2026, printed in the notice as 30.11.26.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the NeGD posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application, for all four positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Program Manager post?
faq.answer: B.Tech./B.E. or an equivalent technical degree is a must. The post also needs 10+ years in technology delivery (12+ years preferred), including a minimum of 3 years managing AI, data or platform programme delivery.

faq.question: Q6. What experience is needed for the DevOps Engineer (AI/ML) post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5-7 years in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, System Administration or related roles. Hands-on experience with AI/ML-based applications, AI model deployment or MLOps practices is required.

faq.question: Q7. Is government experience required for the Program Manager post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says government experience is not required for the Program Manager post.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications will be screened on qualifications, age and relevant experience, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NeGD job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are on contract basis, initially for 3 years and extendable as per the requirement of the project. Appointees get no right or claim to permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate with the application. They may instead produce it at the time of interview.
